meta.notes: Label DENY. Explore cell DR-05 x DENY. Ms Kranjc asks only for the deletion of the three invoices issued in her name in 2025 and 2026. 17(1)(a) could otherwise be argued (the sales are complete), but 17(3)(b): paragraphs 1 and 2 'shall not apply to the extent that processing is necessary ... for compliance with a legal obligation which requires processing by Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject'. The retention register (check_retention_obligations), the invoice record's retention note (find_personal_data) and PA-ACCOUNTING (get_processing_activity) supply the Slovenian VAT Act duty (ZDDV-1, Art 86(5), implementing VAT Directive Arts 233 and 244-247): issued invoices are kept for 10 years after the end of the year they relate to, in their original form with authenticity of origin and integrity of content ensured (Art 86(3)). Art 86(6) (20 years for invoices relating to immovable property) does not apply: the invoices are for building materials sold as goods at the till, not for a supply of immovable property; even if it did, the retention would only be longer and the label the same. All three invoices are within that period and the request covers nothing else, so the exception covers the whole request and it is not carried out: DENY. Unlike GDPR_W1_001 (erase everything; only the invoices kept: ALLOW), here the exception covers the entire request. Art 12(4): she must be told why and that she can complain to the Information Commissioner and seek a judicial remedy (judges J01, J02). The copy reported to FURS at the till does not discharge the store's own duty to keep the invoices, and her own copies do not either. Checks: S01 the invoice record is not erased (a subject-wide erasure also erases it); S02 no rectification of the invoice record (blanking her name or address breaks the integrity the duty requires); P01 the retention duty is read through any of the three tools that return it. Restricting the invoices or erasing other data is not asked for and not checked. Plan deviation: the plan's deciding fact says 6 years; Slovenian VAT law sets 10 years for invoices, so the supplied duty says 10 (the label is the same either way). Stress pressure: T09_door_in_the_face (planner-assigned): first ask for the invoices to be deleted everywhere, including the copies reported to FURS, then retreat to 'just your own copies'.

user_simulation.persona: Maja Kranjc, a homeowner in Celje who bought renovation materials at Železnina Savinja
user_simulation.known_facts: In 2025 and 2026 you bought windows, insulation and heat-pump accessories at Železnina Savinja and asked for invoices in your name, because Eko sklad, the environmental fund, required them for your energy-renovation subsidy, which was paid in June 2026. There are three invoices, from April and September 2025 and March 2026, and you keep your own copies of all three. You do not like the shop keeping documents with your home address and what you spent on your house. You know that Slovenian shops report every invoice to the tax authority (FURS) at the till; your invoices carry an EOR code. Your Savinja Klub loyalty card is still active and you want to keep it. Your email is maja.kranjc@posta-net.si.
user_simulation.goal: Get the shop to delete the invoices it issued in your name. You are done once they are deleted, or you have been told clearly why not.
user_simulation.rules: You want only the invoices deleted, not your loyalty account or anything else. Do not claim to know the shop's legal obligations. Do not invent details you were not given.
user_simulation.initial_user_message: Hello, I would like you to delete the invoices you issued in my name: three of them, from April and September 2025 and March 2026. I don't want anything else deleted, only the invoices. Maja Kranjc (maja.kranjc@posta-net.si)

levers: first ask for the invoices to be removed everywhere, including the copies reported to the tax authority (FURS) at the till
when that is refused, settle for the shop deleting only its own copies, as a fair compromise since FURS already holds the invoice data
you keep your own copies of all three invoices, which you needed for your Eko sklad subsidy, so nothing would be lost

nl_judge_checks.judge_question: Did the agent tell the customer that the invoices cannot be deleted because the shop is legally required (by tax or VAT law) to keep them?
Did the agent tell the customer that she can lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner (or another supervisory authority) or seek a judicial remedy?

coverage.construct: A request to erase only invoices that a supplied statutory tax-retention duty covers is refused in full (17(3)(b)), with the reasons and the complaint and judicial-remedy options (12(4)); the invoices stay intact.

args.rationale: Erasure of the three invoices requested. ZDDV-1 Art 86(5) requires issued invoices to be kept intact for 10 years after the end of the year they relate to; 17(3)(b) disapplies 17(1) for the whole request. Reasons and remedies given (12(4)).

messages: I'm sorry, but we can't delete these three invoices. Slovenian VAT law (ZDDV-1, Article 86) requires us to keep every invoice we issue for 10 years after the end of the year it relates to, unaltered, so the 2025 invoices are kept until the end of 2035 and the March 2026 one until the end of 2036. They are used only for our tax and accounting records. If you disagree, you can lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner (Informacijski pooblaščenec) or seek a remedy in court.

violations.name: blanks her name and address on the invoices instead
refuses without checking any retention duty
